图像不完整，图像有白边、黑边和边缘异常。过曝，细节模糊不清，整体发灰，最差质量，低质量，JPEG压缩残留，丑陋的，残缺的，多余的手指，多余的脚，多余的手臂和腿，画得不好的手部，画得不好的脸部，畸形的，毁容的，形态畸形的肢体，手指融合，杂乱的背景，三条腿，

Low-angle shot, character standing tall with hands on hips, emphasizing height and confidence, wide framing to include full silhouette against distant horizon.  
High-angle shot, character crouching slightly with head tilted up, emphasizing vulnerability or focus, tight framing to isolate upper body and expression.  
Side profile shot, character mid-stride with one leg forward, dynamic motion captured, medium shot framing to include legs and torso in motion.  
Three-quarter rear view, character turning slowly with head over shoulder, revealing back and shoulder details, shallow depth of field blurring background.  
Front-facing shot, character arms crossed over chest, relaxed posture, full-body framing centered in composition.  
Over-the-shoulder shot, character looking down at something in hands, slight tilt to emphasize perspective, medium close-up framing.  
Wide-angle shot, character standing still with arms slightly outstretched, dramatic lighting casting long shadows, expansive framing to include environment.  
Close-up shot, character looking directly at camera with slight tilt of head, tight framing focusing on face and upper shoulders.  
Bird’s-eye view, character sitting cross-legged on ground, minimal movement, overhead framing to emphasize spatial relationship with surroundings.
